about.brandDesc: GoMate is a minimalist "location teaming" platform focused on hiking in Shenzhen. We believe the best journeys need the right companions. Whether you want to conquer Wutong Mountain, stroll Qiniang Mountain, or explore nameless trails around Shenzhen, GoMate helps you find like-minded hiking partners.

privacy.pageSubtitle: We value your privacy. Here is our privacy policy.

sections.title: 1. Information Collection
sections.content: We collect the following types of information:
items: Account information: email address, username, and password (encrypted) provided during registration
Profile: nickname, bio, and hiking level you voluntarily fill in
Usage data: teams you create, activities you participate in, locations you favorite

sections.title: 2. Information Use
sections.content: We use the collected information for:
items: Providing and improving GoMate platform services
Sending account-related notifications (e.g., password reset emails)
Analyzing platform usage to optimize user experience
Ensuring platform security and preventing fraud

sections.title: 3. Information Protection
sections.content: We take the following measures to protect your information:
items: All data transmission is encrypted via HTTPS
Passwords are encrypted with bcrypt — we cannot view your plaintext password
Regular security audits
Strictly limit employee access to user data

sections.title: 4. Cookie Usage
sections.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to:
items: Maintain your login session
Remember your preferences
Analyze website traffic (using anonymous data)
sections.footer: You can disable cookies through your browser settings, but this may affect the functionality of some features.

sections.title: 5. Third-Party Services
sections.content: We use the following third-party services:
items: Cloudflare: for CDN and security protection
Resend: for sending system emails
sections.footer: These service providers have their own privacy policies — we recommend reviewing them.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights
items: Access: You can view the information we hold about you in your profile
Modify: You can edit your personal data at any time
Delete: You can contact us to delete your account and associated data
Export: To export your data, please contact us

sections.title: 7. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact:
items: Email: hello@gomate.live

faq.question: How to join a team?
faq.answer: On the team detail page, click "Join Request" and wait for the team leader's approval.

faq.question: How to create my own team?
faq.answer: After logging in, click "Create Team" in the navigation bar, fill in team details, departure time, member limits, etc. Once published, other users can apply to join.

faq.question: How to contact the team leader?
faq.answer: You can view the team leader's info on the team detail page and contact them off-platform. We're developing an in-app messaging feature — stay tuned.

faq.question: What do the team statuses mean?
faq.answer: Recruiting (accepting applications), Full (reached member limit), Confirmed (team is set to depart), Cancelled (event cancelled), Completed (event finished).

faq.question: How to edit my profile?
faq.answer: After logging in, click the avatar in the top-right corner to enter "Profile", then click "Edit Profile" to update your nickname, bio, hiking level, and more.

faq.question: What if I forgot my password?
faq.answer: On the login page, click "Forgot Password", enter your registered email, and the system will send a password reset email.
